title: Vending Services Program Machine Complement, Placement and Lease Schedule
content:
The machine complement a Vending Services Program agreement is written for, the one-off charge for siting and commissioning each of those machines, the monthly charge for each machine where the client leases rather than hosts it, the lead time before machines are placed into service and whether low-energy machines are fitted as standard are all printed against the programme held, and each takes the value in the schedule below.

| Programme | Machines the programme is written for | Placement charge for each machine | Monthly lease for each machine | Lead time before placement | Low-energy machines fitted as standard |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Single Machine Snack Service | 1 | 180.00 | 0.00 | 7 calendar days | no |
| Snack & Cold Beverage Bank | 2 | 220.00 | 0.00 | 10 calendar days | yes |
| Combination Vending Bank | 3 | 280.00 | 45.00 | 15 calendar days | yes |
| Fresh Food Vending Service | 4 | 420.00 | 85.00 | 21 calendar days | yes |
| Campus Vending Network Service | 14 | 360.00 | 62.00 | 35 calendar days | yes |
| Managed Vending & Kiosk Service | 8 | 510.00 | 118.00 | 28 calendar days | yes |

All money figures are in US dollars. The placement charge is a one-off charge and falls due once for each machine sited and commissioned; the lease is a recurring monthly charge and is carried for each machine the client leases rather than hosts. The lead time is expressed in calendar days.

### The same figures read programme by programme

The Single Machine Snack Service and the Snack & Cold Beverage Bank carry nothing in the lease column: the figure printed against each of them is 0.00, so no monthly lease charge arises for a machine on either programme. The four remaining programmes each carry a lease figure above zero, which is charged for each machine. The Campus Vending Network Service is written for the largest complement at 14 machines, and the Single Machine Snack Service for the smallest at 1; the largest placement charge for a single machine, 510.00, and the largest monthly lease for a single machine, 118.00, both belong to the Managed Vending & Kiosk Service.

### Worked illustration (hypothetical figures)

On an estate of three machines under the Combination Vending Bank, where the placement charge printed against that programme is 280.00 for each machine, the placement charges come to 840.00 in all, and the monthly lease at 45.00 for each machine comes to 135.00 for the month. The same estate under the Fresh Food Vending Service would carry 420.00 for each machine placed, or 1,260.00 in all, and 85.00 for each machine leased, or 255.00 for the month. These amounts are illustrative arithmetic on the schedule figures and are not themselves programme figures.
